text.autoconfig.asmpshopget.title: ASMP Utils
text.autoconfig.asmpshopget.option.sendU: Send Username to track mod installs
text.autoconfig.asmpshopget.option.enabl: Module that tracks shops and sends them to the shop website
Module that tracks waystones and sends them to the website
Module that allows creating waypoints by pressing the 'Add Waypoint' button on the shop website
Module that enables commands. If turned off commands such as /shopsite wont work
April fools 2026 module that renders all water one block higher (Expect performance penalties)
text.autoconfig.asmpshopget.option.waypo: Select the default color for waypoints created by the ASMP Utils mod.
Select the default type for waypoints created by the ASMP Utils mod. (Normal = Stays until removed, Destination = Deleted when reached).
If enabled, waypoints will be created as temporary (deleted upon disconnecting).
The characters to use as the waypoint initials. Leave empty to automatically use the first character of the waypoint name.
text.autoconfig.asmpshopget.option.ticks: How often to send all the data collected so far to the server (in Minecraft Ticks 20 Ticks = 1 Second). If you dont send your data before closing Minecraft the data will be lost! Default = 30 Seconds
text.autoconfig.asmpshopget.option.track: Enable waystone tracking. If disabled only shops will be sent (if that isnt disabled too but why have this mod then)
Enable shop tracking. If disabled only waystones will be sent (if that isnt enabled too)
text.autoconfig.asmpshopget.option.enabl: Enables or disables the whole mod.
This involves a local web server being hosted on a separate thread
